_about: A model of mirroring one Azure SQL Database into a Fabric workspace. source describes the database as it is today, and you change the other sections. Table names are schema.table. columns_in_onelake lists the columns you expect each table to have once mirrored. In using_the_copy, fix_wrong_rows_in is "Source database" or "Mirrored database". report_join is "Cross-database query" (one T-SQL query that joins the mirrored database and the warehouse) or "Nightly pipeline copy" (copy the mirrored tables into the warehouse first). regional_security is "Carried over by mirroring" or "Set up again in Fabric".
needs: Reports need dbo.orders, dbo.order_lines and dbo.products in OneLake. The auditors asked for dbo.orders_history too.
HR data must never leave the source. That covers hr.salaries today and the hr.reviews table HR adds next month.

Nothing has been set up for mirroring on the server yet. Sam creates the mirrored database and is a Contributor in the workspace today. The connection uses a new SQL login, and its database user should get only what mirroring needs.
The report builder wants to know which columns of dbo.order_lines and dbo.products will be there, and whether dbo.orders_history can be mirrored at all.

Finance found an order with the wrong status. Reports join the mirrored orders with the targets table in SalesWarehouse, a warehouse in the same workspace, and should see changes within minutes. Regional managers see only their own region in the source, through row-level security.

tables.name: dbo.orders_history
columns: the same columns as dbo.orders, plus valid_from and valid_to
tables.note: the temporal history table of dbo.orders
